definitions.explanation: describes drinks (especially wine and sake) or food that has a rich, well-developed flavor and aroma

USAGE:
- {芳醇|ほうじゅん}な⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧ (full-bodied wine)
- {芳醇|ほうじゅん}な⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧ (rich aroma)
- {芳醇|ほうじゅん}な⟦{味|あじ}わい→味わい：11899_ajiwai⟧ (mellow flavor)
Primarily used to describe alcoholic beverages (wine, sake, whisky) and sometimes coffee, cheese, or other aged/fermented products.
A refined, literary word often found in product descriptions and wine/sake reviews. Implies quality and sophistication.
